# intro


```{r setup, results = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}

wave <- "wave1"
atlas_roi_nm <- "schaefer2018_17_200__parcel"
#atlas_roi_nms <- c("glasser2016__superparcel", "glasser2016__parcel", "schaefer2018_17_200__parcel")
suffix <- "__nresamp100__lsall_1rpm__divnormed__demeaned"

## libraries

library(here)
library(data.table)
library(knitr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(mfutils)
library(ggseg)
library(ggsegExtra)
library(ggsegSchaefer)
library(ggsegGlasser)

source(here("src", "stroop-rsa-pc.R"))

## settings

opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, out.width = "100%")
theme_set(theme_bw(base_size = 10))

theme_surface <- list(
  theme(
    axis.text = element_blank(), panel.grid = element_blank(), panel.border = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(), legend.position = c(0.5, 0.5), legend.title = element_text(size = 5), 
    legend.background = element_blank(), legend.text = element_text(size = 5), legend.direction = "horizontal",
    legend.key.height = unit(1/5, "cm"), legend.key.width = unit(1/4, "cm")
  )
)

colors_model <- c(
  target = "#1b9e77",
  incongruency = "#d95f02",
  distractor = "#7570b3"
)


## constants

path_data <- here("out", "decoding")
subjdirs <- list.dirs(path_data)[-1]
path_data <- here("out", "decoding")
fname <- paste0("trainbaseline__", wave, "__svm__", atlas_roi_nm, suffix, "_summarized.RDS")
does_exist <- file.exists(file.path(subjdirs, fname))
subjdirs <- subjdirs[does_exist]
subjs <- gsub(".*decoding/", "", subjdirs)

subset_nms <- c("bias", "pc50", "biaspc50")
names(ttypes)[names(ttypes) == "all"] <- "biaspc50"

## data

l <- enlist(subjs)
for (subjdir_i in seq_along(subjdirs)) l[[subjdir_i]] <- readRDS(file.path(subjdirs[subjdir_i], fname))
d <- rbindlist(l)
d <- d %>% rename(region = roi)  ## to match ggseg

## add behavior:
beh <- fread(here("in", "behavior-and-events_stroop_2022-05-27_nice.csv"))
beh <- beh %>%
  group_by(subj, session, wave, run) %>%
  mutate(trial = trial_num + ifelse(session %in% c("baseline", "proactive"), 108, 120) * (run - 1)) %>%
  select(wave, session, run, trial, subj, time_target_onset, rt, acc)
dat <- d %>% left_join(beh, by = c("subj", "session", "wave", "trial"))
stopifnot(nrow(dat) == nrow(d))

```


```{r}

dat_pc50 <- dat[train_stimset == "pc50" & stimulus %in% ttypes$pc50]
dat_pc50_w <- dat_pc50 %>% pivot_wider(names_from = "variable", values_from = "evidence", names_prefix = "evidence_")

dat_pc50[region == "L_dlpfc"] %>%
  group_by(subj, session, run, variable, congruency) %>%
  summarize(evidence = mean(evidence)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(interaction(congruency, run), evidence, color = congruency)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0) +
  stat_summary(fun.data = mean_cl_boot) +
  facet_grid(cols = vars(session))

dat_pc50 %>%
  group_by(subj, session, variable, region) %>%
  summarize(evidence = mean(evidence)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(session, evidence, color = variable)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0) +
  stat_summary(fun.data = mean_cl_boot, position = position_dodge(0.5)) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, position = position_dodge(0.5), geom = "line", aes(group = variable)) +
  facet_wrap(vars(region))

dat_pc50 %>%
  group_by(subj, variable, region, session) %>%
  summarize(evidence = mean(evidence)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(region, evidence, color = session)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0) +
  stat_summary(fun.data = mean_cl_boot, position = position_dodge(width = 0.5)) +
  facet_grid(rows = vars(variable))
## congruency:L_dlpfc, L_vpm, R_ins, R_vpm
## distr: L_lppc, L_vvis, R_lppc, R_vvis
## tar: L_dlpfc, L_ifc, L_vvis, R_vpm, R_vvis

dat_pc50 %>%
  filter(acc == 1) %>%
  group_by(subj, session, variable, region) %>%
  summarize(evidence = mean(evidence)) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = session, values_from = evidence) %>%
  mutate(evidence_diff = proactive - reactive) %>%
  ggplot(aes(region, evidence_diff)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0) +
  stat_summary(fun.data = mean_cl_boot) +
  facet_grid(rows = vars(variable)) +
  labs(y = "proactive - reactive")



dat_pc50[, .(evidence = mean(evidence)), by = c("subj", "session", "variable", "region")] %>%
  group_by(session, variable, region) %>%
  summarize(stat = t.test(evidence)$statistic) %>%
  filter(stat > 2) %>%
  arrange(-stat)


dat_pc50[, .(evidence = mean(evidence)), by = c("subj", "session", "variable", "region")] %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = session, values_from = evidence) %>%
  mutate(evidence = proactive - reactive) %>%
  group_by(variable, region) %>%
  summarize(stat = t.test(evidence)$statistic) %>%
  filter(abs(stat) > 2) %>%
  arrange(stat) %>%
  View




library(lme4)

fit <- lmer(
  evidence ~ session + run + (session | subj) + (session | target),
  dat_pc50,
  subset = region == "L_dlpfc" & variable == "congruency"
  )
summary(fit)

fit <- lmer(
  evidence ~ session + (1 | subj),
  dat_pc50,
  subset = region == "L_dlpfc" & variable == "distractor"
  )
summary(fit)

fit <- lmer(
  proj ~ session + (1 | subj),
  dat_pc50,
  subset = region == "L_vvis" & variable == "target"
  )
summary(fit)



## brain--behavior models

## OLS
library(broom)
l <- dat_pc50_w %>% 
  filter(train_stimset == "pc50", rt > 0, !is.na(rt), acc == 1) %>% 
  split(interaction(.$subj, .$train_stimset, .$region))
mods <- l %>%
  lapply(
    function(x) {
      fit <- lm(
        rt ~ 
          scale(evidence_congruency):congruency +
          scale(evidence_target):congruency +
          scale(evidence_distractor):congruency +
          scale(mu):congruency +
          session + congruency,
        x
        )
      as.data.table(tidy(fit))
    }
  )
res <- rbindlist(mods, idcol = "id")
res <- res %>% separate("id", c("subj", "ttype", "region"), sep = "\\.")
res <- res %>%
  group_by(ttype, region, term) %>%
  summarize(stat = t.test(estimate)$statistic)


res %>%
  filter(!term %in% c("(Intercept)", "congruencyincon"), abs(stat) > 2) %>%
  filter(grepl("congruencyincon", term)) %>%
  View

res %>%
  filter(!term %in% c("(Intercept)", "congruencyincon"), abs(stat) > 2) %>%
  filter(grepl("congruencycongr", term) & !grepl("mu", term)) %>%
  View


res %>%
  filter(!term %in% c("(Intercept)", "congruencyincon")) %>%
  #filter(grepl("LH_DorsAttnB", region)) %>%
  View

regions <- c(
  "17Networks_RH_SalVentAttnA_Ins_2",
  "17Networks_LH_DefaultB_Temp_4",
  "17Networks_LH_SalVentAttnB_IPL_1",
  "17Networks_RH_DorsAttnA_TempOcc_1",
  "17Networks_LH_DorsAttnB_PostC_3",
  "17Networks_LH_SomMotB_S2_3",
  "17Networks_LH_SomMotB_Aud_2s",
  "17Networks_LH_DefaultB_Temp_4",
  "17Networks_LH_ContB_PFCl_1"
)

dat_pc50_w %>%
  filter(train_stimset == "pc50", rt > 0, !is.na(rt), acc == 1, congruency == "incon") %>% 
  filter(region %in% regions) %>%
  group_by(region, subj) %>%
  summarize(
    rt_target = cor(evidence_target, rt, use = "complete", method = "spearman"),
    rt_distractor = cor(evidence_distractor, rt, use = "complete", method = "spearman"),
    rt_congruency = cor(evidence_congruency, rt, use = "complete"),
    rt_mu = cor(mu, rt, use = "complete"),
    #congr_mu = cor(proj_congruency, mu, use = "complete", method = "spearman")
  ) %>%
  as.data.table %>%
  melt %>%
  ggplot(aes(value, fill = variable)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.5) +
  facet_wrap(vars(region))

dat_pc50_w %>%
  filter(train_stimset == "pc50", rt > 0, !is.na(rt), acc == 1, congruency == "incon") %>%
  filter(region %in% "17Networks_LH_SalVentAttnB_IPL_1") %>%
  ggplot(aes(evidence_distractor, rt))



fit <-
  lmer(
    log(rt) ~ congruency * session +
      evidence_target + evidence_distractor + evidence_congruency + mu +
      (1 | subj),
    dat_pc50_w, 
    subset = region == "L_dlpfc"
    )
summary(fit)


dat_pc50_w$rt[dat_pc50_w$rt == 0] <- NA

fit <- lmer(log(rt) ~ proj_target * congruency + (1 | subj), dat_pc50_w, subset = region == "L_dlpfc" & session == "proactive")
summary(fit)
fit <- lmer(log(rt) ~ proj_distractor * congruency + (1 | subj), dat_pc50_w, subset = region == "L_dlpfc" & session == "proactive")
summary(fit)
fit <- lmer(rt ~ scale(mu) + (1 | subj), dat_pc50_w, subset = region == "L_dlpfc" & session == "reactive" & congruency == "congr")
summary(fit)

dat_pc50_w %>%
  filter(
    session == "reactive", region == "L_dlpfc", congruency == "incon",
    proj_target > -10, proj_target < 10
    ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(proj_target, log(rt))) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm") +
  facet_wrap(vars(subj))

dat_pc50_w %>%
  filter(congruency == "incon", session == "reactive") %>%
  group_by(region, subj) %>%
  summarize(
    # rt_target = cor(proj_target, rt, use = "complete", method = "spearman"),
    # rt_distractor = cor(proj_distractor, rt, use = "complete", method = "spearman"),
    rt_congruency = cor(proj_congruency, rt, use = "complete"),
    rt_mu = cor(mu, rt, use = "complete"),
    #congr_mu = cor(proj_congruency, mu, use = "complete", method = "spearman")
  ) %>%
  as.data.table %>%
  melt %>%
  ggplot(aes(value, fill = variable)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.5) +
  facet_wrap(vars(region))



dat_pc50_w %>% 
  filter(session == "reactive") %>%
  group_by(region, subj) %>%
  summarize(
    target_congruency = cor(proj_target, proj_congruency, use = "complete"),
    target_distractor = cor(proj_distractor, proj_target, use = "complete"),
    target_mu = cor(mu, proj_target, use = "complete")
  ) %>%
  group_by(region) %>%
  summarize_if(is.numeric, mean) %>%
  View




unique(dat_pc50$region)
```
